messages:
Priya Gupta: @here opening intake for model 'argent-v2' uploaded to S3. Model card indicates license: 'NonCommercial-1.0' and a NoDerivatives flag. Can we host this on Hosted API?

Oliver Reed: Not without legal signoff. NC prohibits commercial use; our hosted API is commercial. We need a legal review. Also confirm whether "redistribution" includes serving compiled weights.

Maya Chen: @Priya can you paste the exact license lines? If it's NC we likely can't host. Private/Dedicated might be OK depending on customer contract.

Priya Gupta: snippet:
```
License: NonCommercial-1.0
NoDerivatives: true
Source: https://models.example.com/argent-v2/model-card
Training data: mixed web crawl + permissive corpora
```

Liam Ortiz: Quick note from quant experiments on dev infra: 4-bit PTQ (symmetric int4) + QKV folding gives: 
- MMLU: baseline 63.2 -> int4 62.5 (-0.7)
- Winogrande: 74.1 -> 73.2 (-0.9)
- Latency: ~2.2x improvement on p3.xlarge-like GPU
- Peak GPU mem: ~3x reduction
Small quality hit but promising. Will run more seeds.

Oliver Reed: License aside, we should decide allowed deployment modes. Two immediate paths: 
1) Get legal exception or relicense (rare) -> possible Hosted.
2) If not, mark Hosted blocked and offer it only via Dedicated/Private or BYOL (bring-your-own-license) flow.

Priya Gupta: Also asking about export control: model trained on public web data but contains code snippets. Any red flags?

Liam Ortiz: Ran a quick keyword scan on training sources — nothing flagged as controlled tech, but found a handful of terms that need review. I'll attach the provenance CSV to the ticket.

Maya Chen: Action items from legal POV:
- Priya: upload model-card + training provenance to the legal review folder (S3) and tag me.
- Oliver: run our license-scan tool and paste results.
- Liam: upload quantization eval CSV and diffs vs our baseline.
We will triage and respond within 3 business days.

license-bot: License scan complete -> status: noncommercial; recommended_hosting: deny_hosted; report: s3://legal-reports/1793456789-argent-license.json :warning:

Priya Gupta: Setting intake.status = "blocked-hosted" and priority = "high" for legal review. Also adding export_control_flag = "pending". Will update ticket and ping legal.

Oliver Reed: For the intake checklist I propose adding these fields to the form: 
- license_class (permissive / reciprocal / noncommercial / proprietary)
- commercial_ok (bool)
- export_control_flag (none/pending/blocked)
- allowed_deployments ([hosted, dedicated, private, byol])
- license_scan_report (link)
This will let automation route to the right path.

Liam Ortiz: I'll run 3 more quantization seeds tonight and post a CSV with per-task deltas. If regressions > 1.5 pts on aggregate we won't recommend int4 for prod.

Maya Chen: If legal denies Hosted, keep clear instructions in model metadata: e.g., `allowed_usage = ["research", "internal", "private_deploy"]` and `hosting_restrictions = "noncommercial"`. That prevents accidental onboarding to Hosted.

Priya Gupta: Thanks all — I'll update the intake ticket and add the links. Looping in @legal for formal review. :thumbsup:
